Package routine_handler.components.core

Class RoutineClock

  • java.lang.Object
    • routine_handler.components.core.RoutineClock
  • public final class RoutineClock
extends java.lang.Object
    A class representing a clock for routines. This is used to adjust the speed at which a variable loop routine performs its updates
